includes: Unlimited trainer tools, also after the 30-day trial: invite as many clients as you want with a WhatsApp link.
Send homework to your clients and pause, resume or change it whenever you want.
See how much each client practices at home: weekly sessions, success rate and history.
300 bones every month for the AI tools.
Your clients use PAWS for free: they don't pay anything to get your homework.
huesitos: They're added every time the month is charged.
They expire at the end of that subscription month and don't roll over: each month you have 300 again, not 300 plus what you had left.
They're used before purchased or welcome bones, so the ones that expire go first.
If you run out before the end of the month, you can buy a pack. Purchased bones never expire.
Only your account can use them: they can't be given to your clients.
not: Bones for your clients: each client has their 20 welcome bones and can buy packs if they want.
Features that are already free for everyone (dogs, trainings, calendar, progress…): those don't change.
billing: Charged monthly and renewed automatically until you cancel.
Cancel anytime from “Manage subscription”. You stay PRO until the end of the month you've paid for and you won't be charged again.
If you're a founder, your 50% off stays as long as you're subscribed, even if you cancel and come back later.
Secure payment with Stripe. Receipts and invoices are sent to your email.
without: You can still see your clients, their dogs and how they practice.
You can't invite new clients or send or change homework.
You can keep using AI with the bones you have or by buying packs.
Pro.seeHuesitos: See bone packs and everything you can do with them →

HuesitoShop.subtitle: Bones for PAWS AI tools. One-time payment, no subscription.
HuesitoShop.successText: Your bones will show up in your balance in a few seconds.
HuesitoShop.taxIncluded: Taxes included. Secure payment with Stripe.
HuesitoShop.proTip: Are you a trainer? PAWS PRO includes 300 bones every month.
HuesitoShop.legal: By buying you accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms>. Bones can be used from the moment of purchase.
HuesitoShop.errorGeneric: Stripe couldn't be opened. Please try again.
what: Bones are the currency of PAWS artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Every time you use an AI feature, bones are taken from your balance.
They are not money: they can't be exchanged for money or refunded once used.
HuesitoShop.usesTitle: What you can do with them
HuesitoShop.usesIntro: They're only for AI features. This is what each one costs:

group-name.name: Group name
group-name.desc: The AI suggests a name for a group of skills.

session-progress.name: Session progress
session-progress.desc: When you finish a session, the AI works out how much each skill has improved.

session-chat.name: Chat question
session-chat.desc: Each question you ask the AI during a training session.

analyze-progress.name: Progress analysis
analyze-progress.desc: The AI analyzes your dog's progress and gives you recommendations.

session-guide.name: Session prep
session-guide.desc: The AI prepares a step-by-step guide for the session.

training-order.name: Recommended order
training-order.desc: The AI recommends the order in which to work on skills.

pet-questionnaire.name: Initial questionnaire
pet-questionnaire.desc: The AI analyzes your dog's questionnaire to personalize its plan.

HuesitoShop.usesExample: For example, 100 bones give you 100 chat questions, or 50 prepared sessions, or 25 recommended orders.
who: Any PAWS account can buy them: dog owners and trainers.
Only the account that buys them can use them. They can't be moved to another account (for example, from a trainer to their client).
HuesitoShop.expiryTitle: Expiry: how long you can use them
expiry: Bones bought in a pack: they never expire. Use them whenever you want while you have your account.
20 welcome bones: given once when you create your account, and they don't expire either.
PAWS PRO bones (300 a month): these do expire at the end of each subscription month and don't roll over.
If you have PAWS PRO bones and purchased bones, PRO bones (the ones that expire) are used first and then purchased ones, so you don't lose any.
If you delete your account, any bones you have left are lost.
not: They're not a subscription: you pay once and it doesn't renew.
They don't unlock trainer tools (inviting clients and sending homework after the 30-day trial). That's what PAWS PRO is for.
HuesitoShop.emptyTitle: If you run out of bones
empty: PAWS keeps working with its basic version, without AI: dogs, trainings, calendar, progress, homework… Only the session chat needs bones.
